content.text:
Subagent orchestration gate
Result: use-subagent-orchestrator
Reason: Strong orchestration signals detected.

Why parallel:
- independent track 1: map branch changes under host repository rules with affected files and uncertainty
- independent track 2: review correctness, host-rule risks, and regression coverage with findings and gaps
Blockers checked: explicit user opt-out, child-agent recursion, strict sequential dependencies, conflicting writes, workspace-write dirty-state isolation, external side effects, privacy/tool limits, unbounded broad agent tasks.
Read-only agents must report whether findings depend on uncommitted changes.
Subagents:
- so_mapper
  mode: read-only
  scope: branch changes under host repository rules
  expected output: affected files and uncertainty
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_reviewer
  mode: read-only
  scope: correctness and host-rule risks
  expected output: real findings only
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_tester
  mode: read-only
  scope: regression coverage
  expected output: targeted tests and gaps
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
